rules: Each non-HQ logical resource has exactly one exclusive Lane owner per assignment_epoch.
Workers self-plan normal work only inside their owned scope; HQ does not author or replenish the normal lane-local backlog.
Workers never update Global Queue, Work Package manifest, Lane Plan, Resource Lock manifest, Shared, App, or PARITY.
Worker N may update only its own status file for canonical progress signaling.
No preloaded task, exhausted historical bundle list, no Queue READY entry, or another Worker being unfinished is not a valid stop condition.
Cross-lane semantic integration, Shared/App adapter resolution, actual integrated iOS build and PARITY judgment remain HQ responsibilities.
A resource may move to another lane only after HQ verifies no unintegrated changes remain on the previous owner branch and increments assignment_epoch.
